118432.name: Chabad of Century City
118432.note: The center's own About page: 'Chabad of Century City was founded in 1999 by Rabbi Tzemach Cunin OBM'; Jewish Journal obituary (2021): 'established in 1999'. (Wikipedia's 1990 can't be right, he was born about 1978; Anash.org puts it after his marriage in 2000.) Archived copies of its chabad.org listing (Wayback Machine) show it at 1145 South Wetherly Drive, Los Angeles (Feb 2011, Feb 2013, Nov 2016); it is now at 1940 Century Park East, Los Angeles, listed there by July 2019, so it moved there between Nov 2016 and July 2019.
